conviction_note: A cat-free Q3 is near-certain to beat a ~$0.58 consensus that carries a cat load, but last year's identical setup (0.79 vs ~0.50) traded -1.07%, so the print is priced; the stock turns on the Q4 Isaias estimate and whether the FY net-income guide ($455-470m) is raised, which the arithmetic allows unless Isaias costs Slide more than ~$80-100m pre-tax, against a +28.9% run-up since 30 Sep to a price above every published target. Findings sum -0.5, scaled -0.22 (p_up 48, abs 5.5): both near zero, consistent.
bar: Q3 2026 EPS consensus ~$0.58 (Earnings Whispers, https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/SLDE), Benzinga snapshots $0.59 and $0.65 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SLDE/earnings-forecasts), Tradersunion $0.55; revenue ~$345-405m. Sources disagree within $0.55-0.65 but all sit far below a cat-free run-rate (Q1 $1.02, Q2 $1.06 diluted). Company guide: FY2026 net income $455-470m, GPW $1.85-1.95bn, reiterated 2026-07-28 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001886428/000119312526321067/slde-ex99_1.htm).
positioning_check: Short interest ~6.9m shares, ~5.9% of float, 6.1 days to cover as of 2026-08-19 settlement (Equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/slde/shortinterest); Benzinga undated snapshot shows 10.07% / 8.63 days. Not crowded on the lower figure, moderate on the higher. No usable option chain (ATM spread 160% of mid), so no skew; put/call OI 0.72 on 482 contracts total. Unusual Whales quotes a ±8.9% implied move off that chain (https://unusualwhales.com/stock/SLDE/earnings), which is not reliable. Tape: +27.78% over 20 days, +5.16% over 5, 1.1% off the 52-week high; $28.75 spot is above the highest published targets ($28 Citizens 2026-10-12, $28 Barclays).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 was a cat-free quarter in Florida: Isaias (landfall near Destin 2026-10-09, after quarter end) was the first US hurricane since 2024, so Q3 should print near Slide's ex-cat run-rate (Q1 diluted EPS $1.02, Q2 $1.06; Q3 2025, also cat-free, had a 13.7% loss ratio) against a $0.55-0.65 consensus that embeds a hurricane-season cat load, i.e. a ~$0.35-0.50 EPS beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same setup in Q3 2025: EPS $0.79 vs $0.49-0.54 consensus, record 48.5% combined ratio, revenue miss; stock -1.07% (2025-11-05). Q2 2026 $1.06 vs $0.85 bought +3.46%; Q1 2026 beat sold -2.44%. Beats are routine and lightly paid.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: every holder knows Q3 had no landfall, which is why last year's identical beat traded flat-to-down. What is unpriced is only the size of the stale consensus gap; if it were priced the published consensus would sit near $1.00, not $0.58.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001886428/000119312526321067/slde-ex99_1.htm) gives the $1.06 run-rate; Q3 2025 analog from https://www.reinsurancene.ws/slide-reports-record-numbers-in-q325-with-48-5-cor-and-111m-net-income/. Peer UVE printed Q3 2026 diluted EPS $1.80 with net loss ratio down 5.6 pts (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000891166/000089116626000092/a3q26uveex-991xearningspre.htm).

findings.finding: Guidance headroom: H1 2026 net income was $274.4m ($139.5m Q1 + $134.9m Q2) against a reiterated FY guide of $455-470m; a cat-free Q3 of ~$120-140m puts nine months at ~$395-415m, leaving Q4 to deliver only ~$40-75m when Q4 2025 alone earned $170.4m, so the guide can be raised unless Isaias costs more than roughly $80-100m pre-tax.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 2025 print (2026-02-24), which carried the first FY2026 guide, bought +9.68%, the name's largest reaction; the Q2 2026 reiteration with a beat bought +3.46%. Management called its posture 'conservative' on the Q2 call.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced in the +28.9% move since 30 Sep. Published FY EPS estimates (Tickflow avg $3.28, 2026-08-01, https://tickflow.io/stock/SLDE/forecast) sit at or below the guide, so the street is not modelling a raise; if it were, consensus FY EPS would sit above ~$3.70.
findings.independence: Q1 net income from https://www.streetinsider.com/Globe+Newswire/Slide+Reports+First+Quarter+2026+Results/26383569.html. Shares the Q4 line with the Isaias finding below; the two net on one guide and are filed apart because they rest on different documents.

findings.finding: Isaias Q4 loss is the live risk: Insurance Journal (2026-10-08) notes Slide does not file Panhandle exposure reports with OIR and that such non-filers likely hold some of the largest policy counts in the 10-county Panhandle; Slide's 2026-27 first-event retention is up to $166.8m, and Florida OIR counted 46,509 claims / $582m as of 2026-10-15 with industry estimates $1-4.5bn. The release will carry a Q4 Isaias estimate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior cat event since IPO (July 2025). In Idalia (2023, pre-IPO) the CEO reported far fewer claims than expected (https://insuranceinsiderus.com/article/2c4w2bq2fvqddxri9i2v4/floridians/slides-idalia-claims-coming-in-lower-than-expected-ceo-lucas).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock rose from $25.14 (2026-10-09, landfall) to $28.75, so the market is pricing a light Isaias outcome for Slide; a retained loss toward the $166.8m retention would not be in that price. Slide's 10-K does not place any Panhandle county in its top-10 TIV counties (Panhandle sits inside 'All Other FL, 57 counties', 34.9% of TIV), which limits but does not bound it.
findings.independence: Retention from Slide's 2026-06-04 reinsurance release via https://www.artemis.bm/news/slide-renews-5-463bn-of-total-aggregate-reinsurance-limit-first-event-capacity-hits-3-98bn/; claims counts https://floridaphoenix.com/2026/10/19/hurricane-isaias-leaves-582m-in-insured-damage-states-seeks-237m-from-fema/; HCI's northern-Florida tower ($15m retention) is being hit (https://www.reinsurancene.ws/hcis-reinsurance-tower-and-token-affected-after-claims-from-hurricane-isaias-hit/). Against: UVE said Isaias claims were 'less significant than initially anticipated' (UVE 8-K, 2026-10-22). Proxy, not a Slide number.

findings.finding: Peer read-through already delivered: UVE's Q3 2026 release (2026-10-22) showed ceded premium ratio down to 27.6% from 32.7% on its 2026-06-01 program and Isaias claims 'less significant than initially anticipated'; UVE traded +0.9% next day and SLDE rose +2.4% and +2.9% on 10-22 and 10-23.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SLDE moved with the peer print in the two sessions after it; no prior UVE-to-SLDE read-through sample.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced (SLDE +5.4% over the two sessions after). Residual is Slide's own ceded cost: its aggregate limit rose 65% to $5.463bn while rates fell, so Slide's ceded ratio may not fall like UVE's; if the market had that, consensus revenue would not range $345-470m.
findings.independence: Slide CEO on 'substantial' risk-adjusted rate decreases at renewal: https://www.artemis.bm/news/slide-lifting-reinsurance-tower-to-3-5bn-for-2026-rate-decreases-substantial-ceo-lucas/. Price data Yahoo chart.

findings.finding: Positioning: SLDE is +28.9% from its 2026-09-30 close ($22.31) to $28.75, within ~1% of its 52-week high and above the highest published targets (Citizens $28 on 2026-10-12, Barclays $28; Benzinga consensus ~$24), so a beat-and-reaffirm leaves little room.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 cat-free beat into a flat tape traded -1.07%; Q1 2026 beat traded -2.44%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself; the claim is that the run-up has pre-spent the beat. If it had not, the stock would sit near analyst targets rather than above them.
findings.independence: Baseline run_up_20d_pct +27.78%, pct_from_52w_high -1.13%; short interest ~5.9% float (Equibles, 2026-08-19) is not crowded, so no squeeze offset.

findings.finding: Florida market is softening: UVE's Florida direct premiums written fell 3.3% in Q3 2026 and Slide's CEO described risk-adjusted rate decreases as substantial; Slide needs H2 GPW of ~$927m-1,027m (H1 $922.8m) to hit its $1.85-1.95bn guide, against Q3 2025 GPW of $463.4m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GPW growth decelerated from +49.1% (Q1) to +16.7% (Q2) and the stock still rose +3.46% on Q2; top-line has not been the traded line.
findings.why_not_priced: Small; analysts track premium growth. If priced, GPW guide-low risk would show in revenue estimates, which range widely ($345-470m).
findings.independence: Slide's Q2 release (GPW +16.7%, double-digit growth outside Florida), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001886428/000119312526321067/slde-ex99_1.htm. Proxy from a peer.

baseline_tension: No skew to read; the cat-free beat and guide headroom agree with the run-up, which means they are largely priced, while the one unpriced risk (a heavy Isaias retention) cuts against the run-up, so p_up sits just under 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction): Q3 cat-free beat cut from +1.0 to +0.5 because the identical Q3 2025 setup traded -1.07%

Rule 3 (read the set): guidance headroom (+1.5 -> +1.0) and Isaias risk (-1.5 -> -1.0) land on the same Q4 guide and were pulled toward each other so neither carries a size the other's document argues against
Rule 6 (bar): consensus sources disagree within $0.55-0.65; all far below run-rate so the beat direction is robust, print_vs_bar trimmed 70 -> 65
p_up moved 50 -> 48 for the run-up above all targets with an unpriced Isaias tail; abs_move unchanged at 5.5
